events.title: Feedback
events.summary: Feedback WelcomeFeedback is greatly appreciated and helps improve Kito: Lost Trail.If you’ve played the demo, please consider sharing your thoughts, whether it’s about gameplay, performance, level design, controls, or anything else.Feedback: Feedback-LinkThank you for taking the time to play and share your feedback!

events.title: Critical Demo Fix – Foot IK Issue Resolved
events.summary: Demo Update – Critical Foot IK Fix We’ve fixed a major Foot IK issue in the packaged demo of Kito: Lost Trail.The bug caused serious problems with character movement and animations in the packaged version and could make the demo unplayable.The issue has now been fixed, and a new corrected demo build is available.If you experienced strange movement, animation problems, or other issues with the character while playing the demo, please try the updated version.Thank you so much for your patience and

events.title: The Kito: Lost Trail Demo Is Now Available!
events.summary: The Kito: Lost Trail Demo is now available!Join Kito on his journey through the jungle and play through the first level of the game. Explore, jump, solve puzzles, and discover what awaits you along the way.Download the free demo and start your adventure!Thank you for playing Kito: Lost Trail!
